scope: Local source audit only; no SSH, source changes, model forward or training. Proposed pilot differences are explicit.

rotation_and_fk.rot6_order: Concatenate matrix column0 xyz then column1 xyz; NOT row-major reshape of first two columns.
rotation_and_fk.rot6_to_matrix: Gram-Schmidt: normalize a1; normalize a2-dot(b1,a2)*b1; b3=cross(b1,b2); stack as columns.
rotation_and_fk.geodesic_zero_note: The clamp creates a small positive floor even for identical rotations; preserve for old-scale comparisons.
rotation_and_fk.global_rotation_fk: p_root=0; p_j=p_parent + R_global_parent @ rest_offset_j. Do NOT multiply parent rotation into an already-global predicted rotation again.
rotation_and_fk.fk_input_units: XWBC rest_offsets and positions are centimeters; Y-up; root-relative.

static_descriptor.rest_off: Raw spec.rest_offsets float32[J,3], including the original root offset. No reach division.
static_descriptor.norm_bonelen: l_j=norm(rest_offsets[j]); height=sum_j(l_j) or 1.0; bonelen_j=l_j/height. Sum includes root offset.
static_descriptor.height_warning: This code variable is total offset length, not standing height, not skeleton diameter, not reach.
static_descriptor.hop: int64[J,J], undirected parent-child shortest-path distances, diagonal0; disconnected=1000000.
static_descriptor.depth: hop[first index where parents<0,:], raw integer edge count; do not rescale.
static_descriptor.joint_feature_order: raw offset3 | normalized offset direction3 | norm_bonelen1 | depth sine4 | depth cosine4 | dof19 =34D
static_descriptor.attention_hop: GraphBiasAttention clamps hop to max_hop+1 (default17) only when indexing hop embedding.
static_descriptor.root_offset_note: FK ignores root offset by setting p_root=0; descriptor and norm_bonelen still use it. Preserve first-cache spec for warmstart.

loss_contract.main: For each source->target direction: mean(geodesic_deg)/30 + w_pos*mean(norm((FKpred_cm-FKgt_cm)/target_reach_cm,dim=-1)); old w_pos=5.
loss_contract.reduction: Euclidean xyz norm, then batch/joint mean, NOT coordinate MSE. Main direction terms are divided by len(step_combos) before backward.
loss_contract.old_rootpos: w_rootpos*smooth_l1(raw_hpos[:,target_root,0],target_root_gap_m), default beta=1.0 in meters and mean reduction; old stage2 w_rootpos=3.
loss_contract.rootpos_channels: Only root channel0 has a direct height target. Root channels1/2 and nonroot hpos are not XYZ-supervised when fk_loss=true.
loss_contract.rootpos_pilot_fix: Compute only on root_height_valid & isfinite values, independently of the old if-cex block; no fake root height for UniMate. Select valid rows BEFORE arithmetic.
loss_contract.old_contact_geometry: h=FKpred_y_cm/100 + GT_root_gap_m + rotated sole offset y (meters); trust-mask rows. pen=mean(relu(-h)^2); cgeo=BCEWithLogits((thr-h)/(thr/3),contact_soft).
loss_contract.contact_inheritance_limit: Original sole/contact fields omitted from first minimal transfer; source-sealed supplement now required before loader accepts XWBC. Never replace sole with joint-center geometry.
loss_contract.old_reencoding: With probability0.3: mean((zp_re-zp)^2)+mean((zr_re-zr)^2), weighted1.0; reencode cat(predicted_global_rot6,raw_hpos). Original latent targets are not detached.
loss_contract.old_contrast: Flatten and concatenate decoder-ready zp,zr; L2 normalize per row; similarity/tau (tau0.1); 0.5*(CE(sim,arangeB)+CE(sim.T,arangeB)); average over unordered body pairs; old weight0.5.
loss_contract.contrast_pairing_limit: Only same physical source motion+timestamp across bodies is a positive pair. Never align unpaired UniMate rows by incidental array index; avoid duplicate sampled rows becoming false negatives.
loss_contract.old_judge: Original onehot BCEWithLogits, grad mode, w.1 restored with reinitialized16class auxiliary head and verified current body map; historical class mapping unproven.

inherit: topology hops and exact static descriptor construction
dual FSQ levels13x32 and compatible old tensors
valid-only root height regression in meters
XWBC InfoNCE.5 tau.1 6bodies, exact duplicate rows stable-deduplicated
16class judge grad/.1, new current label map and reinitializedhead
ground pen200/contactgeometry1 with source-sealed true soles and trust masks
original 8combo mean, maskprob.3 six-mode policy and independent contact input
explicitly_disable: temporal world-slip and hpair derivative losses: missing complete adjacent/world-root/time observations
UniMate cross-body contrast/judge/metric-ground terms: genuine absent supervision
selected_single_frame_pilot_policy.cannot_copy_adjacent_loss: Old hpair/slip uses r,r+1 and hardcoded30fps. Current subsampling has >=3 original-frame gaps and only sparse rows; table-neighbor rows may be different clips.
future_temporal_requirements: contact states with correct target geometry
selected_single_frame_pilot_policy.preprocessing_precision: Old full-data PoseStore stores pose9 fp16 then casts gathered batches to fp32; extracted payload is full fp32 by request. Weight compatibility does not imply bit-identical old inputs.
selected_single_frame_pilot_policy.metric_eval: Derive positions from predicted rotations via FK. Do not copy old evaluate()/eval_dual pos_cm, which reads raw hpos by default.
selected_single_frame_pilot_policy.nonmetric_external_data: Retain normalized geometric losses only if scale is unknown; never label normalized UniMate values centimeters/meters.
selected_single_frame_pilot_policy.raw_hpos_cycle: Raw decoded hpos feeds unconditional cycle, while metric XYZ loss remains independent rotation FK.
selected_single_frame_pilot_policy.extra_sparse_task: Additional XWBC same-body pure-SE3 branch with probability.25 weight1; does not replace original8direction main branch.

manifest_schema.body_payloads: list[16] of body,J,payload(relative path),payload_sha256,payload_bytes,reach_cm,source_rotations(list),source_contacts(list),static_descriptor(relative path), static_files{spec,dof,descriptor}: each path+sha256; spec/dof also source_path+source_sha256
manifest_schema.total_bytes_before_final_manifest: integer; size observed before final manifest/checks writes

loader_acceptance: Require both final JSON files; progress.json or existing partial payloads are not completion.
manifest.status==complete; rows==30322; bodies==16; exact unique body-name coverage matches chosen_split.body_names; both check lists cover16.
checks.all_pass is true; inspect actual per-body finite/formula/root/validity checks too.
Verify chosen_split and row_table SHA256 against manifest, then every payload file SHA256 before accepting data.
Validate each NPZ row count/J/required fields and identical row_ids/split/group_index across all bodies against row_table.
Independently verify group split disjointness and declared old-heldout membership from chosen_split.

Require sealed hashes for every static spec/dof/descriptor; validate derived descriptor against copied spec. Legacy spec joint_names is a NumPy object array, narrowly read only after its byte SHA256 matches seal. Motion payloads forbid pickle.
For this initial single-frame pilot, derivative losses stay off even when selected row order happens to be sorted.
xwbc_completion_contract.current_status: Last remotely confirmed extraction was9/16; host subsequently Tailscale Offline. No final completion claim.
xwbc_completion_contract.legacy_seal_policy: A completed pre-seal extraction requires source manifest digest validation and byte comparisons to verified original cache_lafan_v3 spec/dof; no payload re-extraction. Newly observed DOF/descriptor hashes are explicitly source_revalidated_at_seal_time, not historical trusted hashes.
